title: Dirtywave M8
subtitle: Tracker · Model:02 · firmware 6.6.3
description: Songs built step by step, hands-on technique tutorials, and a library of instrument patch cards to load and play.

pages.title: How these pages work
pages.summary: The play strip, the pictures, and what a dashed box means.

sections.title: Low Tide
sections.description: Slow, wide trip-hop in D minor at 84 BPM. Pads that swell and darken, a round bass, swung drums, a hand-written arp, and a sound you record on the road.

pages.title: The plan and the setup
pages.summary: Where the harmony is going, and why. A new song at 84 BPM.

pages.title: The pad sound
pages.summary: Hypersynth on one held note: an open Dm9, a small detune, a one-bar swell and an eight-bar filter tide.

pages.title: The chords
pages.summary: Six open chord banks over one held note, switched with CRD so nothing re-attacks. A quiet roots track underneath.

pages.title: The bassline
pages.summary: One two-bar figure written in D, moved to every root by the chain's TSP column, with a slide into each new root.

pages.title: Drums and swing
pages.summary: A no-sample beat from Macrosynth drum models, and a 07/05 groove on the drums and bass only.

pages.title: The duck
pages.summary: A trig envelope on the pad, fired by the kick: the pad breathes on every hit.

pages.title: The arp
pages.summary: A bell arp written by hand through each chord, with chance and a dotted-eighth echo.

pages.title: Texture
pages.summary: Record a sound where you are on the M8's mic and loop it low under everything.

pages.title: Arrange it
pages.summary: Seven song rows: intro, entries, a breakdown where the DJ filter closes, and an outro.

pages.title: The mix
pages.summary: Balance, a side-only low cut for the wide pad, the reverb sends, and the limiter.

sections.title: Techniques
sections.description: Hands-on walkthroughs of Tables and sampling.

pages.title: Tables
pages.summary: A table arp: TABLE TIC, the N and V columns, HOP, TBL, and why a table follows the root but not the chord.

pages.title: Sampling
pages.summary: Load and the pitch limit, start and loop, slices, recording, resampling, and the Zoom M4 route for pitching down.

sections.title: Patch cards
sections.description: Every instrument from the songs, plus other good ones to try. Use next and previous to page through them.

pages.title: Tide pad
pages.summary: Warm, wide Hypersynth pad on one held note: one-bar swell, two-bar fade, eight-bar filter tide.

pages.title: Roots
pages.summary: A quiet near-sine floor that breathes with the pad. Low Tide, track 2.

pages.title: Polaroid chords
pages.summary: WAV PARAPHONIC chords picked by COLOR, one COL per bar. From your M8.

pages.title: Polaroid arp
pages.summary: Hollow triangle pluck with a tape wobble. Faded Polaroid's arp.

pages.title: Velvet bass
pages.summary: Warm, filtered saw that breathes under rootless chords.

pages.title: Struck bell
pages.summary: A small pitched bell with a dotted-eighth echo. Low Tide’s arp voice.

pages.title: No-sample drum kit
pages.summary: 808-style kick, snare and hats from Macrosynth models. Low Tide’s beat; no samples needed.

pages.title: Acid bass
pages.summary: Squelchy resonant saw: filter envelope, velocity accents, slides.

pages.title: Glass keys
pages.summary: FM electric piano with a glassy tine. Glass Garden's second chance.

pages.title: Field recording loop
pages.summary: A sound recorded on the M8's mic, looped low under everything.
